---
title: "Set up the AI's API key"
subtitle: "SOP SYS-02 · Technical systems manual"
---

## Purpose

Create the API key that lets the shop's app send paperwork to the AI
(Anthropic's Claude), and put it where the app reads it, so that **Have the
AI read it** works when someone checks a copy of paperwork (GRM-06) and the Technical workbench can run the AI.

## Applies to

The person responsible for the shop's database and AI. Repeat this procedure
whenever a key expires, is lost, or may have been seen by someone it should
not have been.

## Before you begin

- The shop's app runs on this computer with Docker, from the
  `dog-groomer-platform` folder.
- You can sign in to the Claude Console at
  [platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com), or create an account
  there. The account pays for what the AI reads, so the shop must add a
  payment method or buy credits on the Console's
  [Billing](https://platform.claude.com/settings/billing) page.

::: {.callout-warning}
## The key is a password
Anyone with the key can use the AI and the shop pays for it. Never email it,
paste it in a chat, or put it in any file other than `.env`. The `.env` file
is never saved to GitHub.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## What the AI is sent
When someone clicks **Have the AI read it**, the pages of that copy are sent
to Anthropic's API. The screen says so beside the button.
:::

## Procedure

### Create the key

1. Open a browser and go to
   [platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com). Sign in.
2. Go to the **API keys** page:
   [platform.claude.com/settings/keys](https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys).
3. Click **Create key**.
4. Type a name that says what the key is for, for example
   "Grooming shop app".
5. Choose an expiration. When the key expires, the AI stops working until you
   repeat this procedure, so note the date.
6. Set **Linked account**. Choose yourself, or a service account if the shop
   has one. A key linked to a person stops working if that person leaves the
   organization.
7. Click the button to create the key. The Console shows the full key, which
   starts with `sk-ant-`. **It is shown only once.** Click the copy button
   beside it. Do not close the window until step 13.

### Put the key in the app

8. Open the `dog-groomer-platform` folder in File Explorer.
9. Find the file named `.env`. If there is no `.env`, copy `.env.example`
   and rename the copy to `.env`.

   If File Explorer does not show `.env`, click **View** at the top of File
   Explorer, then **Show**, then tick **File name extensions** and
   **Hidden items**.

10. Right-click `.env`, click **Open with**, and click **Notepad**.
11. Find the line that starts with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=`. Click at the end of
    the line, after the `=`, and paste the key. If an old key is already
    there, delete it first. Nothing else goes on the line: no spaces and no
    quotation marks.

    ```
    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-…your key…
    ```

12. Find the line that starts with `EXTRACTION_MODEL=`. Make sure it names a
    current model, for example `EXTRACTION_MODEL=claude-sonnet-5`. The list
    of current models is at
    [platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview).
13. Click **File**, then **Save**. Close Notepad. You can now close the
    Console window.

### Restart the app so it reads the key

14. Open a terminal in the `dog-groomer-platform` folder.
15. Type this command and press Enter:

    ```bash
    docker compose up -d --force-recreate api review
    ```

    Docker restarts the shop's app and the Technical workbench. Wait until the
    terminal shows each one as **Started**.

### Check that it works

16. Open the shop's app, sign in, open any dog's card, and click **Add
    paperwork**. Take a photo or choose a file of any vaccine paperwork,
    click **Save it**, then click **I'll check it now**.
17. Look for the **Have the AI read it** button above the date form. Click it.
    After a short wait, the form shows **The AI filled in** a number of
    vaccines.

    If you do not want to keep this test copy, click **Remove this copy and
    start again** before step 17, or remove it afterwards from Admin. See
    [MGR-05](../manager/paperwork-to-check.qmd).

## Result

**Have the AI read it** reads the pages and fills in the dates. The key
appears on the Console's API keys page, with the date it was last used.

## If something goes wrong

### The AI isn't set up on this computer. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and EXTRACTION_MODEL to .env.

One of the two lines in `.env` is empty, or the app was not restarted. Check
steps 11 and 12, save the file, and repeat step 15.

### The AI isn't set up on this computer: the API key in .env was not accepted.

The key is wrong, has expired, or was deleted in the Console. Check that the
line in `.env` has the whole key with no spaces. If it still fails, create a
new key (steps 1 to 7) and replace the old one.

### The AI model … named in .env doesn't exist. Check EXTRACTION_MODEL.

The model name in `.env` is misspelled or no longer offered. Copy a current
model name from the models page in step 12, save, and repeat step 15.

### The key may have been seen by someone else

1. On the Console's [API keys](https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys)
   page, find the key and delete it. It stops working at once.
2. Create a new key and put it in the app (steps 1 to 15).

### The AI works, but the shop is spending more than expected

The Console's [Billing](https://platform.claude.com/settings/billing) page
shows what has been spent. Use
[workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/settings/workspaces) in the Console
to set a spend limit for the key's workspace.
